question: Is a Vedic fire rite accepted within a Śiva temple according to this teaching?
premises: Vedic fire rites exist as a ritual category.
The Śiva temple has its own prescribed ritual order.
Not all external rites are accepted there.
inference: Therefore a Vedic fire rite is not desired in a Śiva temple.
plain_english: Whatever Vedic fire rite there may be is not accepted in a Śiva temple.
